data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=JQqpBnVwYisQ7kNvgHYOG5U&_nc_ht=scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBranUs-Q0bvUNesvFkWZyStpXxd7RKbye1iW5NN1fzkA&oe=671A301C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NCuhz5A5SOMQ7kNvgEUoOX3&_nc_ht=scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAU8BdVb3zjinZncPCGvQeNb7osTfwj86k3ieOxZKqP7Q&oe=671A39A4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=2dNm1fOCB9IQ7kNvgHt_TC5&_nc_ht=scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAnJAH-wODneZCse1-R65XT4LoJExhJQbpQyrsYEkP8lg&oe=671A2107)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=lrZ0Dn1_LOIQ7kNvgENUTX0&_nc_ht=scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDDz1FsNKJVNK-ApNsSVTs5_gSE_VBx3jrOlhB3SQ0wjA&oe=671A13E6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=twtsgMiq_uQQ7kNvgFm1rfQ&_nc_ht=scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDfs1XkqoW31q1ZScbsKpggxxSSFHHJIVTYqQqy2j-Erw&oe=671A4058)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=1xZIt32vqOMQ7kNvgEjXTtJ&_nc_ht=scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBdOmiPzhfkr0qz0oc2iNu21gKoTw9PwVVc9mSTB8aXug&oe=671A3CD9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=v6fDAQjG32kQ7kNvgGT6j3V&_nc_ht=scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAuZhAVwzklVKXAJrUzoaynczROupRWMEkgd8snMLRxJg&oe=671A22F0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Ly6kakmYK6YQ7kNvgFmsQvI&_nc_ht=scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCSLdX7dSYTmtn4qhsv9Hzy_-3CNLM1eo_6PUwNhelRvA&oe=671A45AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=gPZUkeRwbWwQ7kNvgFnMYD1&_nc_ht=scontent-ams2-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAwm3Gnm9aEa_rZ_EI61oI0Lc49ky1Hdv4K5Hk3I3dxDw&oe=671A2117)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=DDDhFxZD6I0Q7kNvgFewrnL&_nc_ht=scontent-ams4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCdWAUuSQnIR16WN-5MD003w_cJT_NJ1q5nrRvVJhmmww&oe=671A3C8C)
